_metadata.description: Explicit planned requirements for operational targets that are not yet implemented or backed by live test evidence.

requirements.title: Auto-updater hooks
requirements.description: When a signed release is published to a configured channel, generated Electron applications shall discover, verify, download, and apply the permitted update without bypassing release policy.

validation.notes: Generated templates carry the electron-updater wiring. A signed feed and an observed detect/download/apply/relaunch sequence remain required before this requirement can be complete.

requirements.title: Deployment eligibility report
requirements.description: When a desktop target is selected, the system shall resolve required host and resource prerequisites and record an eligible, degraded, or ineligible reason in the artifact manifest.

validation.notes: Requires a Linux and Windows-target preflight report plus the corresponding generated artifact manifests.

requirements.title: Release trust boundary
requirements.description: When production resources are bundled, the system shall accept only a release-authority-signed manifest while retaining an explicitly non-promotable development-local path.

validation.notes: Requires independent development-local and production verification against a release authority signature.

requirements.title: Isolated desktop-console evidence
requirements.description: When the console performs a mutating desktop journey, the system shall use a routed leased state root and retain BAS evidence of the generated artifact, build, and smoke outcome.

validation.notes: Requires a routed BAS run that proves the lease, generated artifact, build result, and smoke report.

requirements.title: Code signing + notarization
requirements.description: For each supported signing platform, the release pipeline shall produce a platform-appropriate signed artifact and complete the required notarization step where the platform requires it.

validation.notes: Planned: validate generated signing and notarization configuration against credential-free fixtures and controlled platform runners.

requirements.title: App store submission automation
requirements.description: When a release is approved for a configured store, the distribution pipeline shall produce the store submission artifact and record the provider response as deployment evidence.

validation.notes: Planned: use provider sandbox fixtures to validate submission packaging and evidence recording.

requirements.title: Multi-window workflows
requirements.description: When a generated application opens or restores multiple windows, it shall persist the declared window state and route communication only through the approved Electron IPC boundary.

validation.notes: Planned: run a desktop fixture that opens, restores, and exchanges typed messages between multiple windows.

requirements.title: Performance monitoring + analytics
requirements.description: When a generated application runs, it shall record the approved performance and build telemetry with the configured privacy boundary and expose it to authorized operators.

validation.notes: Planned: verify telemetry capture, redaction, persistence, and operator retrieval in a controlled runtime fixture.

requirements.title: Enterprise deployment features
requirements.description: When an enterprise distribution profile is selected, the pipeline shall produce the configured installer format and support its documented unattended-install contract.

validation.notes: Planned: validate Windows and macOS enterprise artifacts on controlled target-platform runners.

requirements.title: Visual desktop app builder
requirements.description: The system may provide an operator interface that composes a desktop application configuration from supported scenarios, templates, and deployment options.

validation.notes: Planned: define an accessibility and generation acceptance flow when the visual builder is implemented.

requirements.title: Plugin architecture for templates
requirements.description: The system may load versioned template feature packs only when their declared capabilities, integrity metadata, and compatibility constraints are satisfied.

validation.notes: Planned: define feature-pack verification and compatibility fixture coverage when the extension model is implemented.

requirements.title: Kiosk mode enhancements
requirements.description: When kiosk controls are enabled, the generated application may enforce the configured hardware restrictions and provide authorized remote-control operations with auditable evidence.

validation.notes: Planned: define controlled-device fixtures and authorization evidence when enhanced kiosk support is implemented.
